By using hairdryerlab.ca you agree to these terms. The short version: this is an information site, not a shop; we publish research and buying guidance; we link out to retailers; and we cannot guarantee that a price, a specification or an availability status is still current when you read it.

Effective date: 2026-10-05

What this site is

Hair Dryer Lab publishes independent research and buying guidance about hair dryers for Canadian buyers.

This site isThis site is not
An information and review publicationA retailer, marketplace or shop
A source of buying guidanceA source of professional or medical advice
A publisher of analysis of public reviews and listing dataA manufacturer, distributor or authorised dealer

We do not sell anything. There is no checkout, no cart, no account and no payment processing on this site.

Purchases happen elsewhere

Every purchase takes place on a retailer’s website, not here. When you follow a link to a retailer and buy something, your transaction is with that retailer and is governed by that retailer’s terms, return policy and privacy policy — not by these terms.

That means:

  • Pricing and availability are set and controlled by the retailer
  • Returns, refunds and cancellations are handled entirely by the retailer
  • Warranty claims are between you, the seller and the manufacturer. We are not a party to them and cannot process them
  • Delivery, delays and damage in transit are the retailer’s responsibility

We may earn a commission on some purchases made through our links. That relationship is described in full in our affiliate disclosure.

Accuracy, prices and specifications

We work to be accurate, and we are explicit about the limits.

Prices change frequently. Every price on this site carries the date we verified it, and we re-check commercial pages monthly. But the price that applies is the one shown on the retailer’s page when you buy — not the one shown here. Always confirm before purchasing.

Specifications come from different sources, and we label them. Where a specification comes from a manufacturer rather than from our own measurement, it is labelled as a manufacturer claim. We have not bench-tested every model we cover, and our guides say so rather than presenting estimates as measurements.

Our review analysis has stated limitations. The review dataset we use skews toward recent and critical reviews, which is why its average rating differs from the ratings displayed on retailer pages. We publish that caveat on our methodology page and use the data for patterns rather than as a substitute for a product’s displayed rating.

Availability changes. A product recommended in a guide may be discontinued, out of stock, or sold by a different seller by the time you read it. Seller structure in particular can change, and seller structure affects who honours a warranty.

We do not warrant that any content is complete, current or error-free. If you find an error, tell us — see contact — and we will correct it and change the page’s last-updated date.

No professional advice

Nothing on this site is medical, dermatological, electrical, safety or professional advice.

Hair dryers are electrical appliances that generate heat, and our guides describe reported buyer experiences and publicly available data. They do not replace the manufacturer’s instructions, the safety information supplied with a product, or the advice of a qualified professional.

If you have a scalp or skin condition, an allergy, or a concern about using an electrical appliance, consult a qualified professional. If you are unsure whether an appliance is safe to use, stop using it and consult the manufacturer or a qualified electrician.

Safety checks we describe, such as inspecting an ALCI plug, are general guidance. They are not a certification that any particular unit is safe, and they do not replace the product’s own safety documentation.

Frequently asked questions

Can I buy a hair dryer from Hair Dryer Lab? No. Hair Dryer Lab is an information site. We do not sell hair dryers, hold stock, process orders or handle payments. Every purchase happens on a retailer’s site, under that retailer’s terms.

Are the prices on Hair Dryer Lab guaranteed? No. Prices change frequently. Every price carries the date we verified it, and we re-check monthly, but the retailer’s price at the moment you buy is the one that applies. Always confirm on the retailer’s page.

Who is responsible if a product I bought is faulty? The retailer you bought it from, and the manufacturer under its warranty. Hair Dryer Lab is not a party to that transaction. We can tell you who held the Buy Box on a listing, which is often the right first contact, but we cannot process a claim.

Can I republish your content? No, not without permission. Our guides, analysis and data are protected by copyright. You are welcome to quote briefly with attribution and a link, and journalists should contact us for data requests rather than copying figures without context.

Do you give medical or professional advice? No. Hair Dryer Lab publishes consumer product information. Nothing on this site is medical, dermatological, electrical or professional advice. If you have a scalp condition, an allergy or a concern about an electrical appliance, consult a qualified professional.

Which law governs these terms? The laws of Canada, and the laws of the province or territory whose courts have jurisdiction over the matter. We serve Canadian readers and we do not claim a specific province as our governing jurisdiction.
